description: Somos estudiantes de la escuela de diseño industrial y queremos aprender más sobre el desarrollo de interfaces.
summary: Re-grow is an accesible mobile app that advises the user how to efficiently plant and harvest with a regenerative agriculture aproach. It helps farmers to face climate change through technology.
details: Our project consists of a user-centric application designed for ease of use, simplifying access and understanding of complex scientific data. This application is significant because it assists farmers in making decisions about their crops through a regenerative approach—a method that supports environmental and soil health, thereby extending the long-term viability of the land. Furthermore, this approach promotes cost reduction by optimizing the use of water and chemical resources, such as fertilizers, herbicides, and fungicides. The project was developed using a Figma prototype, underpinned by C++ (compiled to WebAssembly) and TypeScript. The application’s content draws upon official data from sources including NASA’s GAEZv4, Copernicus, GPM, SMAP, SRTM, USDA, Landsat, GEDI Ecosystem Lidar, and NASA POWER. The innovation in our project lies in the solution provided through a simple graphical interface, as well as the application’s core concept: it goes beyond merely providing information to actively guiding users in their crop-related decision-making process through personalized suggestions.
